comparison.objective: Shake a stopped separatory funnel to mix two liquid layers, periodically vent it safely, then replace it in its support.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual vessel handling, vigorous inversion/shaking, valve operation, outlet-direction control, and safe reseating.
comparison.success_condition: Required mixing strokes and venting are completed without stopper loss, drainage, spill, or unsafe vent direction; funnel ends supported and stoppered.
comparison.reason: Tests dynamic liquid handling and pressure-relief sequencing, not rigid insert finishing or recovery of fractured metal tangs.
